text: Reads the active document of the session (ensureDoc -> activeDoc).
Changes the workspace on screen (openAssetInDesigner sets ui.workspace).
No position argument: it goes above the document's active layer; a text layer takes the text tool's style (ui.text).
"new" and "replace" depend on the document's active layer.
Depends on the document's active layer and records no undo by itself (the stroke that follows does).
